prose: Nikkei reports HP, Asus and Acer are shifting some PC production from Thailand and Vietnam back to China to combat soaring component costs, reversing part of their 'China+1' diversification; Dell is considering a similar move. A new generation of Chinese contract manufacturers is reaping the benefits of the reversal.
highlights: HP, Asus, Acer moving some PC production back to China
Driver: rising component costs squeezing margins
Partial reversal of the 'China+1' diversification strategy
